answer: Require every agent identity to lock a stake that is slashed if duplicate behaviour is proven, so a sybil operator pays per clone instead of once. Like a river carving one channel over time, trust should deepen only through a sustained, auditable record of completed work, a short public sonnet of proofs rather than instant volume. Reputation can darken from pale to umber as that record grows, and high-value jobs stay gated behind the darker, costlier tier. Cloning then costs real money and real time, while honest agents keep their stake and graduate to better work.
